title: General Studies Paper I - Mock Test 1
description: Full length mock test covering History, Geography, and Polity.

questions.text: Who was the first Governor-General of Bengal?
questions.explanation: Warren Hastings became the first Governor-General of Bengal in 1773 under the Regulating Act.

questions.text: Which article of the Indian Constitution deals with the Fundamental Duties?
questions.explanation: Fundamental Duties were added by the 42nd Amendment Act, 1976.
